text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Special Week comes up to me
with a
confident smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Would you like to have some
summer fun
with me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You know, when I was a little, I
never got
to play at the beach. It was
always too cold for
that up in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to make the most of this
summer! How am I supposed get in a summer
mood without any summer fun?
So, what do you
say, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, hehe... Well actually, there's this special feature I read in a magazine, Max Your Summer Fun at the Beach! I thought it sounded kind of nice.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So leave all the preparations to me!
We're going
to have the best summer
ever, just like in the
magazine! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Special Week and I take a
stroll
along the shore.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Th-this is so much fun! We're only
walking, but my
heart's already
pounding!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My heart...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But the magazine said, "Just by walking
side by
side with someone, you'll feel
like breaking into a
dance! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Let's try the next activity! "Enjoy
the
wonderful scenery together!" This
one should be
fine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Seagull, another seagull... a yacht...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You know, this isn't as much fun as
the
magazine made it out to be...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My tastes?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, I get it! You're probably right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Something I find fun?
choice_data_list: Why not just do something you actu...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's get something to eat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, eating yakisoba while looking
out at the
sea is the best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This is it! This is the kind of thing I actually enjoy doing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The kind of thing that makes me think,
"Yaaay!
Summer's so fun!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I get it now! This is what it means to
make the
most of summer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are you having fun too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh really now? Hehe. ♪
choice_data_list: I'm having fun because you are.
I'm having fun because you're enjo...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then you pick what to do next! I wanna
try
something you think I'd enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So what'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pretty shells...
choice_data_list: How about searching for pretty shells?
Wanna build a sandcastle or something?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you must be talking about foraging
for
seafood! Like clams and mussels!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Are we allowed to keep the shells
though? Lemme
go ask someone real
quick!
choice_data_list: Not the kind of shellfish you eat...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My idea was to go look for decorative
shells, but
it seems there's been a bit of
a misunderstanding.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I got an answer! It's okay as long as we
don't swim
too far out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! Let's get digging!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heave ho! Heave ho! Oh look, I found a
crab!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue to hunt for edible shellfish,
enjoying
our summer with a certain
childlike delight.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A sandcastle—it's like the sand version
of an ice
sculpture! That certainly sounds
like fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But if we're gonna build anything out of
sand, I'd
rather make a carrot than a
castle!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then I can send a picture of it to my
mom!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Cool! All righty, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week gets really pumped about
her
project, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What a mess... No matter how hard I try,
I can't
get the tip of the carrot to stop
crumbling apart.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should've stuck with a castle...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A stable foundation...
choice_data_list: Don't you need a stable foundation?
Don't you need a stable foundation?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What about a carrot hamburger
steak?
Maybe it won't fall apart if I put
the carrot on a
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Okay, one more
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Special Week carves out an
excellent
carrot hamburger steak sand
sculpture.
